description: Open-source, lightweight consent SDK for React, Next.js and plain JavaScript: cookie banner, script gating, Google Consent Mode v2, IAB GPP and TCF.
rules: The SDK never looks up a visitor's location; pass region context from trusted host headers with resolveRegion.
Optional categories default to false under GDPR; gate tags with @cookiechimp/scripts presets or GatedScript.
In the Next.js App Router, CookieChimpProvider from @cookiechimp/nextjs/server is a server component that prevents banner flash.
Opt-in subpaths (gate, dynamic, network, consent-mode, gpp, tcf) are never in the default bundle.
